lines.sentence: Up in the front of a taverna, a bard sits restlessly before the maid behind the bar, giddy in the afterglow of his performance.
Thank you so much for letting me share my stories here, Laurel! You know it means the world to me.

Of course. The passion in your voice is a comfort to hear. Although, I am surprised to hear that you weren’t singing a love song to some valiant miss or mister though. It sounded much more inspired tonight. Personal.
I know! It was like I had a stroke of inspiration. A muse in the form of the goddess of stories! It was wonderful. She held herself with strength and care, much like how you do Miss Laurel!
Yes well, your usual room is ready for the night. Let me know if you need anything alright?

No please, let me know if YOU need anything. Especially since I will likely be heading out soon. I would like to see the road for a while, but I promise when I return I’ll tell you everything about what I’ve found!
The bard, giving a small but dramatic bow before pardoning himself from the bottom floor, ascending to his room.
I appreciate it, but dear, I can promise you’ll need it more than me. Your story will be wonderfully vibrant. Painted with life and emotions deeper than most will see.
I can’t wait to bear witness to it.
